split_policy: Canonical export flushes validation at document 50000 before starting train; source code reviewed. Downloaded 80 train shards form a prefix; final partial document is not a complete-document hash comparison.
source_docs_cache_limitation: 48GB source JSONL not redownloaded/re-tokenized; provider-pinned shard hashes, split code/manifest and tokenized-document overlap checks establish bounded provenance, not a new independent raw-corpus rebuild.
